heading: Frequently Asked Questions
support: Straight answers from our Portland remodeling projects. For anything else, reach out for a free estimate.

items.question: What remodeling services does Rip City Construction offer?
items.answer: Rip City Construction is a Portland remodeling contractor specializing in kitchen remodeling, bathroom renovations, ADU construction, home additions, basement finishing, and full residential remodeling throughout Portland and surrounding areas.

items.question: How long has Rip City Construction been in business?
items.answer: Since 2012. Rip City Construction is family-owned and operated in Portland, and most of our work comes from referrals and repeat clients.

items.question: Where does Rip City Construction work?
items.answer: We serve Portland and surrounding areas, including SE Portland, NE Portland, Beaverton, Lake Oswego, Tigard, and Milwaukie.

items.question: Do I need a permit to finish my basement in Portland?
items.answer: Yes. Finished basement work, especially a new bedroom or bathroom, is permitted through the City of Portland Bureau of Development Services. Fees are a small fraction of the budget, and permitted space counts as finished square footage at resale.

items.question: Can a finished basement become an ADU later?
items.answer: Often, yes. A basement ADU needs its own egress, adequate ceiling height, and usually a separate entrance, so it pays to rough in plumbing and electrical with that future in mind. Our ADU and home addition work includes basement conversions, and we can tell you in one visit if your basement qualifies.
